name: broadcast
description: Unified media framework: scripted channels, dynamic news, live cameras, recorded footage.

tune.note: KNOWN GAP: raw tune verb gates on broadcast_receiver-flagged furniture; discovery is via the use/watch/tv specializedAction panel, not the verb. `use` and `watch` are both registered against tag 'tv' OR flag 'broadcast_receiver', so either marker alone surfaces them on examine; the handler additionally accepts furniture merely named like a television.

tablettune.note: Internal — the Tablet TV app's dial. Needs no furniture (the tablet is its own receiver); sent only by the TV app's viewport, never typed.

load.note: KNOWN GAP: `load cassette` gates on media_deck furniture; discovered via the use/media_deck panel, not the verb.

eject.note: KNOWN GAP: gates on media_deck furniture; discovered via use/media_deck panel.

selectcassette.note: KNOWN GAP: client-driven cassette pick; gates on media_deck furniture; use/media_deck panel is the discovery path.

guess.note: The game-show answer verb. Inert everywhere except a channel's studio_zone_id while a gameshow round is open; discovery is the host's on-air invitation, which carries the teachVerb shimmer. Not furniture-gated — the studio floor and the live round ARE the gate.
